description: Run a scene in Godot 4.7 headless and measure it the way a player feels it: frame-time p50, p95, p99 and max against a budget (default 16.6 ms), the physics step apart from the rest of the frame, the slowest frames with what changed on them (nodes made or freed in one frame, a heavy physics step, script work), node and orphan counts, and the change since the last run of the same scene (kept in .godot/godotwright/perf/). Headless measures the CPU side (scripts, physics, scene work), not the GPU. `input` plays a timeline as godot_play does, to measure while something happens. An error result when p95 is over budget or more than 10% worse than last time. Lessons that fit the numbers are named. Measure before and after every performance change.

baseline.description: compare with and save the last run of this scene (default true)

path.description: project folder, or a file or folder inside it (relative to the server's folder; default: the current project)

scene.description: the res:// scene to measure (default: the main scene)

warmup.description: frames to run first without measuring (default 60)

name: godot_perf
title: Measure a scene's frame times
